name: M3_CRS111MI_Get
description: Retrieve a specific e‑mail address from the central e‑mail address repository based on an e‑mail type and an e‑mail key value. The call returns three values: the e‑mail type, the e‑mail key value that uniquely identifies the related object, and the actual e‑mail address. Common configuration uses type values such as 1 = Customer, 2 = Supplier, 3 = Employee, 4 = User, with additional types for roles like payer or invoice recipient so different business roles can have separate addresses.

inputParameters.name: EMTP
inputParameters.description: E-mail type indicating for which object (customer, supplier, employee, user, etc.) the e-mail address is to be retrieved.

inputParameters.name: EMKY
inputParameters.description: Key value identifying the specific customer, supplier, employee or user whose e-mail address is to be retrieved, depending on the e-mail type.

outputParameters.name: EMTP
outputParameters.description: E-mail type for which the e-mail address is registered (customer, supplier, employee, user, etc.).

outputParameters.name: EMKY
outputParameters.description: Key value identifying the customer, supplier, employee or user the e-mail address is registered for.

outputParameters.name: EMAL
outputParameters.description: E-mail address registered for the specified key and e-mail type.
